_comment: Copy this file to config.json and fill in your own values.
_target_interface_substring_comment: Substring matched against RNS interface names (e.g. from your Reticulum config's [[Name]] section) to decide which interface to watch. Only announces received DIRECTLY (1 hop) on a matching interface are logged/notified.
_renotify_interval_comment: Minutes before the SAME destination can trigger another notification. Every matching announce is always logged regardless; this only throttles repeat notification messages. 1440 = 1 day. Set to 0 to disable renotify entirely and only ever notify once per destination.
_min_minutes_between_notifications_comme: Global floor on how often ANY notification can be sent, regardless of how many distinct new destinations show up. The per-destination renotify setting above only throttles repeats of the SAME destination - this instead protects against a burst of many different new destinations firing a wave of messages all at once (e.g. right after first deploying). A suppressed notification is not marked as sent, so it will be reconsidered the next time that destination announces. Set to 0 to disable this safeguard.
_excluded_identities_comment: Identity hashes (lowercase hex, no separators) to ignore entirely. Leave empty to include everyone, including your own devices.
_outbound_propagation_node_comment: Destination hash of an LXMF propagation node to route notifications through (e.g. your own lxmd instance, if running one locally). Set to null to send direct-only with no propagation fallback.
_notify_recipients_comment: Who gets notified. pubkey_hex is the recipient's raw 64-byte LXMF public key (128 hex chars) - e.g. from an lxma:// contact URI (lxma://<dest_hash>:<pubkey_hex>), NOT the destination hash itself. This lets the watcher message someone without needing to have already seen them announce.
